name: NGFI-A binding protein 2
pathways: negative regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase III

function.text: NAB2 encodes NGFI-A-binding protein 2. Annotated molecular activities include transcription coregulator activity and transcription corepressor activity. It participates in regulation of DNA-templated transcription and negative regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase III.

germline.text: No constitutional disease assertion was retrieved in the reviewed GenCC snapshot; this does not exclude a germline association.

somatic.text: Reported somatic alteration contexts include Solitary fibrous tumor, malignant/high-risk. The alteration class and exact variant must be assessed in the disease context.
